title: Ina P NDE 3341
content: I was scared at first everything around me faded to darkness. I heard a voice - I was told while I was out of it I kept repeating 'Dolly.' I was following the voice and it lead me to a cliff, all I could see was a little needle of light but the ledge was sharp. I got scared but the voice commanded me to follow saying it would be okay. I fell off the cliff and felt like I was being wrapped in warm, peaceful blanket. While going through this light, peace surrounds you and all anger, hatred, emotions leave until only peace exists. I kept falling going deeper into the light. When I finally hit I was at awe with it - so beautiful; a golden gate so much peace. I had my left hand on a golden gate and I slowly open it. I had my right foot across. All of a sudden, I heard my mom. Half way across the gate, with my left foot in the air, I turned away and I saw darkness, then light, then my body below. My mom was crying begging me to come back yelling, 'Ina no!' Then she hit me. After that, I woke up and tried to find out why I was in the hospital. My mom told me my heart and lungs stopped - I was going through total body shutdown and my mind was still running. I was under for almost five minutes. They told her I was going to be gone. My face was white and lips were blue the whole time. My body felt like ice. They kept me in the hospital for a week but never found out what caused it so they said a high fever. That's all they had. That's all I know.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Followed a voice to a sharp ledge/cliff; fell off and kept falling deeper into a needle of light.

arrival.other_being_detail: A commanding voice telling her to follow and that it would be okay.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described a 'golden gate' and intense peace while moving through light.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Reported 'total body shutdown'; later told it may have been due to a high fever.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Cliff/ledge leading to falling into light; golden gate boundary; heard mother calling and then returned.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Transitional phase described as darkness/voice/cliff/fall rather than a classic tunnel; OBE-like view of body occurred near the boundary/return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A commanding voice led her to a sharp cliff/ledge; she fell off into a 'needle of light' and later reached a 'golden gate' which she partially opened and stepped through before returning.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I fell off the cliff and felt like I was being wrapped in warm, peaceful blanket.” “While going through this light, peace surrounds you and all anger, hatred, emotions leave until only peace exists.” “My mom was crying begging me to come back yelling, ‘Ina no!’”
